authority_closure: Every native public operation validates the exact A1 reference and calls A2T with the exact receipt, external receipt hash, external authority hash, the A1 snapshot hash and current observed_at.
Ledger definition_snapshot_ref and execution_trust_authority_ref are immutable genesis fields and their definition hashes must be identical.

claim_acquired resolves owner_principal_id with required_role claim_owner, every capability through resolve_execution_capability_refs, every gate through resolve_execution_gate_ids and every verification rule through resolve_execution_verification_policy before append and again during genesis replay.

evidence_recorded accepts only a rule required by its active claim and resolves reviewer_principal_id through resolve_execution_independent_reviewer against that claim owner and rule; aliases sharing the owner subject digest fail.

Snapshot active claims, unresolved gates, effect capabilities, evidence digest and dispatch_ready_claim_ids are derived solely from full trusted ledger replay; native validation rebuilds the entire expected snapshot and requires byte equality.

A claim is dispatch-ready only while acquired_at <= observed_at < lease_expires_at, all required gates have latest decision approved, every required rule has qualifying PASS evidence and no required-rule FAIL, capabilities are nonempty and all A1/A2T pins remain current.

Accepted release requires the same readiness at occurred_at, the exact derived evidence-set digest and an independent_review_evidence_digest naming a qualifying PASS; blocked/cancelled release grants nothing.
transition_imported and compare_only snapshots have empty active claims, ready claims, unresolved gates, capabilities and evidence authority; they never claim, mint, approve or dispatch.

Idempotency is exact canonical event identity only; same key with any semantic difference fails. Replay starts at genesis, verifies every event hash/predecessor/sequence and derives all state without trusting counters or projections.
No class instance, caller-supplied top-level capability list, unresolved-gate list, readiness flag, reviewer role, policy digest or evidence summary is accepted as authority.

budgets.preallocation: enforce byte, token, item, node, depth and string budgets before recursive conversion, projection or encoding
budgets.replay_complexity: O(total canonical bytes + events + bounded active-scope comparisons); no scan of all prior events per event

control_plane.decision_enabled: register one exact four-path tests-first writer claim
control_plane.failure_action: one bounded target correction, then release_blocked on recurrence

correction_budget.on_repeat: release_blocked, preserve materialized drafts and require fresh Root/Sol architecture; no second patch, compatibility layer or model reroute

errors.boundary: every public API raises a fresh module-owned allowlisted error from None
errors.content: code, path and detail are fixed built-in bounded strings; paths contain fixed schema names and numeric indices only; no input key/value, callback, repr, exception or document text

normalization.unexpected: capture_failed at the fixed owned boundary

forbidden: fifth writer path or edits to accepted A1, A2T, routers, guidance, validators, runtime, dispatch or persistence
v1 compatibility, authorizing class, registry, generic adapter, validator helper, receipt verifier, authentication, signature service or capability minting layer
caller-supplied snapshot capabilities, unresolved gates, dispatch/readiness boolean, reviewer role or policy digest
raw evidence, source, private paths, free prose, callback text or exception text in ledger/snapshot/errors
filesystem persistence, Git mutation, subprocess, provider, network, private data, worker dispatch, live action, stage, commit, push or deploy
hostile_matrix: historical fully rehashed top-level capability widening, unresolved-gate deletion, readiness addition and projection substitution
zero, max and max-plus-one for every per-event, ledger aggregate, active-authority, snapshot and transition-document budget
unknown capability, gate, verification rule or principal and A2T receipt/authority/definition/time pin substitution
owner/reviewer casefold aliases, two principal IDs sharing one subject digest, wrong policy role and reviewer field spoofing
ledger/snapshot/overlay duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, huge integer tokens, trailing bytes, noncanonical whitespace, malformed UTF-8 and self-rehash
Mapping/Sequence subclasses, hostile __class__, items, iter, len, getitem, equality, hash, encode, serialization, str and repr at every public boundary
post-capture mutation, retained alias replacement, repeated-read disagreement and mutable returned projections
lease boundary equality, stale observation, expiry, renewal-after-expiry, nonmonotone time, fork, orphan, replay and idempotency collision
NFC/NFD, case, slash, drive, dot, ancestry, reserved and trailing-dot-or-space path aliases
compare-only forged claim, capability, gate, evidence or ready-claim projection
static zero imports/calls to filesystem, persistence, subprocess, provider, network, dispatch, worker, private-data or live adapters

representation.authority_objects: forbidden; no authorizing Ledger, Event, Snapshot or Overlay class

canonical_json.canonical_bytes: byte-for-byte required for ledger, snapshot and overlay validation

capture.array: type(value) is list or type(value) is tuple only; tuple captures once to list
capture.ownership: capture each accepted input once into a private exact tree and never reread or retain caller-owned mutable state
capture.protocols: no isinstance Mapping/Sequence and no __class__, iter, len, getitem, items, equality, hash, encode, str or repr callback on a non-exact input
capture.scalars: exact str, int, float, bool or None only; bool never satisfies integer

representation.hashes: sha256: plus 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters over canonical unsigned bytes
representation.ledger: exact built-in immutable canonical JSON bytes containing its own hash
representation.public_mutable_results: fresh exact built-in dict/list copies only
representation.snapshot: exact built-in immutable canonical JSON bytes containing its own hash
representation.transition_overlay: exact built-in immutable canonical JSON bytes; compare_only only

residual_limits: A2T proves catalog membership, policy role and subject-digest independence; it does not authenticate a human/agent or verify a cryptographic attestation. This slice must not claim either.
When the pinned trust authority or its principals expire, new native readiness fails closed; authority succession or epoch rollover is future architecture.
The compare-only adapter proves exact transition-byte parity and zero authority only; it does not migrate or rewrite Open Work or Round7.

route.recommended_worker: gpt-5.6-terra high; the coupled trust, replay, lifecycle and parser rewrite requires implementation judgment under the frozen representation

router_preclaim_snapshot.rule: Root materializes fresh post-registration router pins in the writer claim; router bytes are never worker-owned.

stop_rule: Stop before dispatch on any baseline, pin, router, ownership, model-route or collision drift, missing exact test node, packet contradiction or need for a fifth path. After dispatch, one bounded correction only for the declared class.

target.outcome: Two pure modules expose one bounded append-only execution ledger and one point-in-time snapshot whose native authority is reconstructed only from exact A1 and A2T pins; compare-only transition input always projects zero execution authority.
target.trust_boundary: Trusted orchestration supplies the exact pinned A1 reference, exact A2T receipt hash, authority hash and current observed_at. A2 consumes this trust; it does not authenticate principals, verify attestations, persist state, dispatch work or perform effects.

tests_first.final_review: fresh Root/Sol deep review on the identical frozen candidate
tests_first.focused: all ten exact nodes and complete two-file suite pass; record the exact collected total after tests-first before source edit
tests_first.historical_semantics: retain or rewrite all 51 previously passing focused cases so the complete two-file suite covers every prior lifecycle, hash, path, parser and compare-only invariant
tests_first.independent: freeze exact four candidate blobs, packet digest, all read-only pins, router revision and dirty-diff digest; fresh QA repeats exact10, full focused, dependency, static, hostile matrix and real central checks
tests_first.order: edit tests only, materialize test blobs, collect all ten exact nodes, run them red with only declared product failures, then edit sources
